surface_verification.justification: No web surface exists for this change and the Backend-affects-Frontend rule does not fire: the diff touches only vendored Python under scripts/ci/, two CI workflow comments plus one pytest invocation, .gitattributes, .trivyignore.yaml's header, and planning docs. No API route, store mutation, SSE/WS handler, message contract, or any code consumed by the UI is modified - confirmed by the diff's file list, and corroborated by the client suite (335 files, 3131 tests) passing untouched. The deliverable IS a CI gate, so it was verified at ITS OWN surface instead: the real vendored CLI was executed against mutated copies of this repo's live state (probes P0-P5 plus the doubt-review state X), and every new or changed guard was falsified - seen RED with an actionable message - not merely seen green. That is stronger evidence for this change than a browser run could produce.
